By Dan Primack · Oct 08, 2026

🍷 Sunrise greetings from Napa Valley, where I'm in town for some VC event stuff. Plus wine, so it's probably best that Lucinda handle the newsletter tomorrow morning. Have a great long weekend, and I'll be back with you on Tuesday.

📺 "People really want me to die." Check out a new episode of The Axios Show, featuring Madison Mills' conversation with longevity entrepreneur and influencer Bryan Johnson. Watch here.

Top of the Morning
 

Illustration: Aïda Amer/Axios
 

Venture capital is in the midst of a record-shattering year, but the big numbers mask some underlying softness.

  • In short, there's tons of money for startups squarely in the AI bucket. If not, good luck to you.

Driving the news: Venture capitalists invested over $98 billion into 3,640 U.S. companies in the third quarter, according to the PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor released this morning.

  • That's a bit of a slowdown from the first two quarters of 2026, likely because both Anthropic and OpenAI took a breather.
  • The 2026 total now stands at $516 billion invested, which is 44% higher than the highest full-year tally (2021) and 61% more than last year's total.

Zoom in: AI accounted for a whopping 82.7% of deal value in 2026 and around 45% of deal count.

  • That sort of sector concentration surpasses even dotcom days, and poses challenges for maintaining a diverse startup ecosystem. And that's exacerbated by increased fundraising challenges for emerging managers, as LPs plow more and more commitments into mega-scale firms.
  • Moreover, 90% of disbursements are for rounds of at least $50 million, up from 77% in 2025. And the market's longstanding exit problems persist.
  • Venture is at its best when it's taking lots of shots on different goals, rather than all firing at the same corner of the same net.

Yes, but: Categorizing companies as "AI" is getting increasingly murky, as virtually every startup marketer has gotten the memo. And inflation is distorting historical dollar data.

The bottom line: The bull case is that a rising tide will eventually lift all ships, and returns will get recycled into larger and more sustained LP allocations to venture. The bear case is that there's too much cargo at the bow, without enough accessible drainage.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Brendan Lynch/Axios
 

Spectrum Equity Investors tells Axios that it's raised $2.5 billion for its eleventh flagship fund, with a continued focus on tech companies.

Why it's the BFD: This is one of the few veteran growth equity/buyout firms not motoring up-market, despite the siren call of lucrative fees.

  • Spectrum raised $2.2 billion for its tenth flagship fund in 2022.

The bottom line: "When you look at things like our at-entry revenue and employee headcount, it's been remarkably consistent over the last 15 years. Median revenue in the low 20s and median enterprise value in the mid-to-high 100s. If you squint you can see marginal differences in enterprise value, but we're not chasing the unicorn phenomenon." — Spectrum managing director Ben Spero
 
 
Venture Capital Deals
 

• Manus, a Chinese AI agent startup, raised over $500m in its first round after Meta was forced to unwind its $2b acquisition. Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led, joined by insiders Tencent, HSG, and ZhenFund. axios.link/4iauo96

• Oratomic, a Pasadena, Calif.-based quantum computing startup, raised $475m in Series A funding at a $5.4b valuation from Arch Venture Partners, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Bezos Expeditions. axios.link/47Nsqp7

🚑 Matchpoint Therapeutics, a precision medicine biotech, raised a $150m Series B co-led by Nextech Invest and Norwest and joined by Sanofi Ventures and Digitalis Ventures. axios.link/4zmB4XD

⚡ Veir, a Woburn, Mass.-based developer of superconducting power delivery systems, raised $110m in Series C funding, per Axios Pro. Matter Venture Partners and Tyche Partners led, joined by LG Technology Ventures, Gates Frontier, Sabanci Climate Ventures, and Hui Capital. axios.link/3Ttgw0t

• Parallel, an LA-based autonomous electric freight rail startup, raised $100m in Series C funding from AVP, Hillspire, Agility Global, Cobalt Capital and insiders Anthos Capital, Congruent Ventures, Riot Capital, and Collaborative Fund. axios.link/4hTCguC

• Universal Quantum, a U.K. large-scale quantum computing startup, raised over $100m in Series A funding. DCVC and Firgun Ventures led, joined by EDBI, Artal, Integral GlobalTech, Main Sequence, Hostplus, NGS Super, IAG Capital, EdenBase, Eigenstate.holdings, Dave Baszucki, Nauta Capital, and The Venture Collective. axios.link/4jR2mRc

• Mecka AI, a developer of data and deployment infrastructure for training physical AI, raised $60m in Series B funding. Sequoia Capital led, joined by Kindred, Framework, Neo, Nvidia, Microsoft, Qualcomm, and Samsung. axios.link/4yHHOPS

• Gallatin AI, a military logistics startup, raised $50m in Series A funding from firms like 8VC and Silent Ventures, per Axios. axios.link/4s2XYAP

🚑 Yazen, a Swedish digital health startup focused on weight loss, has raised €50m. Verdane led, joined by insider Evli Growth Partners. axios.link/474lHXR

🚑 Healthleap, an SF-based startup identifying undiagnosed illness risk in patient records, raised $38m in seed and Series A funding from Sequoia Capital, First Round Capital, and Hummingbird Ventures. axios.link/4y3nF5D

• Meanwhile, a provider of life insurance in bitcoin, raised $37.5m at a $350m valuation, per Axios Pro. Bain Capital Crypto led, joined by Haun Ventures, Framework, Apollo and Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures. axios.link/3VpwwBc

• Gardens Interactive, a social gaming studio, raised over $35m from Lightspeed, Sequoia, Index, Accel, Stanford University, the Nintendo Family, the ZeniMax Family, Eric Schmidt, and the founders of Slack and FunPlus. axios.link/4dWQERo

• Wiremind, a French provider of revenue management and ticketing software, raised €35m. Seaya Andromeda led, joined by IronWave and Bpifrance. axios.link/4ziorwH

🚑 Vitalize, an SF-based hospital staffing and scheduling startup, raised $31m. Oak HC/FT led, joined by Norwest Ventures, .406 Ventures, Constellation Ventures, YC, and MemorialCare Innovation Fund. axios.link/4hKHgRT

• Catalyst, a developer of trading agents for retail investors, raised $30m, per Fortune. Sequoia Capital led, joined by Jump Trading, PeakXV, Lux Capital, AntiFund, Coinbase, and Premji Invest. axios.link/4jgsYet

🚀 Fortastra, an LA-based developer of spacecraft for on-orbit security and national defense, raised $30m in Series A funding. First In led, joined by Upfront Ventures, Space Capital, Rsquared, Side Door Ventures, and ATX Ventures. axios.link/4hJmlP9

• TrueLayer, a U.K. account-to-account fintech, raised $27m. An Italian state-backed group led, joined by Stripe and Tiger Global. axios.link/4yJXFO4

• Rein Security, an Israeli runtime security platform for enterprises, raised $25m in Series A funding. Glilot Capital and Sienna Venture Capital led, joined by Corner Ventures, Atlacle, and RNP Capital Advisors. axios.link/3VTL2Be

• ByteXL, an Indian B2B edtech startup, raised $9m in funding. Elevar Equity led, joined by Kalaari Capital and The Michael & Susan Dell Foundation. axios.link/4yFOqyi

• Netsec, a provider of cybersecurity and managed IT services, raised more than €8.9m. Partech led, joined by Primo Capital and View Different. axios.link/4j6bEso

• Trmeric, a San Ramon, Calif.-based agentic enterprise platform, raised $6.5m in seed funding. Hitachi Ventures led, joined by Schema Ventures, CerraCap Impact Venture Capital, FalconX Ventures, and Executive Venture Fund. axios.link/4yaedO1

• Hilt, an SF-based data security startup, raised $4.2m in seed funding. Array Ventures led, joined by Verdict Capital, Base10 Partners, Brickyard, Liquid 2 Ventures, Sequel, the Sarah Smith Fund, and Alumni Ventures. axios.link/4721YYN

• Agentiq Sports, a NYC-based fintech for fans to indirectly invest in professional athletes' careers, raised $4m led by Defy VC. axios.link/4hP3faD

• Egoist Machines, developer of an "AI passport" for making personal context portable, raised $3m in seed funding from backers like Goodwater Capital and YC. axios.link/4hNLFn8

• Iridium Credit, an NYC-based invoice verification company for lenders, raised $3m led by Field Ventures and MGV. axios.link/4hP3mmz

• Myca, an Indian developer of AI agents for agribusiness field teams, raised $1.3m in pre-seed funding. Kriscore Capital and Eximius Ventures led, joined by Indigram Labs Foundation. axios.link/4B09q4u

• One Trading, a European regulated derivatives trading platform, raised funding from Nasdaq Ventures. axios.link/4dp1TBZ

Private Equity Deals
 

• Acuity Analytics, backed by Permira, acquired Continuus, a Milwaukee-based data consultancy specializing in financial services. axios.link/4zHmiLp

• Ardurra Group, backed by Littlejohn, acquired Enprotec/Hibbs & Todd, an Abilene, Texas-based water and wastewater engineering consultancy. axios.link/4y5FpNC

• Bertram Capital invested in Percopo Coatings, a Longwood, Fla.-based provider of coatings and restoration services. axios.link/4rPQuRA

• BlueMatrix, a Thoma Bravo portfolio company, agreed to acquire Aiera, an NYC-based content delivery platform. axios.link/4rVRhR2

• Chemistry, backed by Breakwater Management, acquired Boston-based creative agency Colossus. axios.link/4jMbSFj

• CFGI, backed by Carlyle and CVC Capital Partners, acquired Dallas-based BAO Consulting Group. axios.link/4AOsSkB

• Kian Capital acquired Integrity Landscape, a Bay Area commercial landscape services group. axios.link/4dslG3q

⚡ Monomoy Capital Partners acquired Creedence Energy Services, a Minot, N.D.-based provider of production and midstream chemical solutions. axios.link/4hI9E7m

• North Branch Capital invested in Callaway Industrial Services, a Morrisville, N.C.-based industrial maintenance firm. axios.link/3VSzxKj

• Stryten Energy, backed by Atlas Holdings, acquired motive battery companies C&D Technologies (Horsham, Pa.) and Trojan Battery (Santa Fe Springs, Calif.). axios.link/4zj9YR0

• Univar Solutions, backed by Apollo, acquired H.M. Royal, a Trenton, N.J.-based distributor of specialty raw materials and chemicals. axios.link/4zmBkpz

🌎 Via Verde, an Italian biomethane developer, raised project funds from Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners. axios.link/4yExtUV
 
 
Public Offerings
 

🚑 Centinel Spine, a West Chester, Pa.-based maker of disc replacement implants, filed for an IPO. It reports $10m of net income on $82m in revenue for the first half of 2026 and plans to list on the Nasdaq (CNTL). Backers include Viscogliosi Brothers and the Oman Investment Authority. axios.link/4jElLVy

🚑 Iambic Therapeutics, a San Diego-based AI drug discovery company, set IPO terms to 9.4m shares at $15-$17. It would have an $809m market cap at the midpoint, and plans to list on the Nasdaq (IAM). The Phase 1 biotech had raised over $350m from firms like Abingworth, Alexandria Venture Investments, Alumni Ventures, ARK, Ascenta, Catalio, Everbright Biofund, and Freeflow Ventures. axios.link/4ze3ItY
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

• Elliott Investment Management and hired BofA and Perella Weinberg to sell Gigamon, a Santa Clara, Calif.-based provider of network visibility and optimization that could fetch more than $2b, per Reuters. axios.link/4ia7Zc1
 
 
More M&A
 

⚡ Crescent Energy (NYSE: CRGY) agreed to acquire Eagle Ford assets from Devon Energy (NYSE: DVN) for around $3.85b. axios.link/47GG9Ou
 
 
Fundraising
 

Photo: Bryan Dozier and Ralph Alswang/Axios
 

• Sriram Krishnan, the former a16z partner who then served as a White House senior policy advisor on AI, is said to be raising $500m for a growth-stage fund focused on AI startups. axios.link/4hSctmx

🚑 Aphias Capital, led by H.I.G. Capital's ex-global health-care head, raised $1.05b for its debut fund, per Axios Pro. axios.link/3VTkksr

• Endeavor Catalyst, an NYC-based venture firm, raised $320m for its fifth fund. axios.link/4hUuOzo

• Swish Ventures, an Israeli firm led by ex-NBA player Omri Casspi, held a $217m close on a new early-stage fund, per an SEC filing.

• Square Peg, an Australian VC firm, raised over A$1b for a pair of new funds. axios.link/4hMO3KO

🚑 TCGX has raised $600m for its Asia Life Sciences Fund I, which will focus on Asian biotechs in various stages of development. axios.link/4yEO62M

• Thomson Street Capital Partners of St. Louis is raising its seventh flagship fund, per an SEC filing.
 
 
It's Personnel
 

🚑 TJ Parker, founder of PillPack (acquired by Amazon), is stepping down as a general partner at Matrix Partners to become CEO of portfolio company General Medicine, per Axios Pro. He'll remain with Matrix as a venture partner. axios.link/4j73zUk
 
 
Final Numbers
 
Data: October 2026 Global Financial Stability Report; Chart: Emily Peck/Axios

Hedge funds are playing an increasingly important role in the two hottest markets of the moment — U.S. Treasury securities and AI stocks — and they're doing it with a lot of borrowed money, Axios' Emily Peck reports:

  • "In times of stress, unwinding that borrowing, or leverage, can turn a sell-off into a crisis that spreads beyond hedge funds into the banking system and the wider economy.
  • "That was the message from a report out Tuesday from the International Monetary Fund, which in its measured way delivered a sharp warning about the growing risk that hedge funds pose to global markets."
 
 

A MESSAGE FROM J.P. MORGAN

A banking team for the AI era
 
 

Sid Sheth, co-founder of tech company d-Matrix, knew he needed a banking team that could keep up with the demands of the rapidly evolving AI landscape. J.P. Morgan was the right choice because of its speed and scale, which helped the company expand internationally.
